game.title: Marvel's Spider-Man
game.blurb: Open-world superhero action-adventure set in New York, from Insomniac Games, released 2018-09-07. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes, with the story order taken from StrategyWiki's walkthrough contents.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: An experienced Spider-Man faces a new gang called the Demons, across 44 story missions from "Clearing the Way" to "Pax in Bello". Spoiler-guarded.

Fandom (marvels-spider-man.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://marvels-spider-man.fandom.com/wiki/Marvel's_Spider-Man
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a real guide at completion stage 1: its Table of Contents lists 44 base-game story missions, and 40 of them have written subpages (from "Clearing the Way" to "Supply Run", about 470 to 9,900 characters each); the last four ("Heavy Hitter", "Step into My Parlor", "The Heart of the Matter", "Pax in Bello") and every page for The Heist, Turf Wars and Silver Lining are not written. Gameplay subpages such as Skills, Suits, Gadgets, Crime, Backpacks, Bases and Challenges also exist. Its structure was recorded in sw-structure.json; mission names only, no text copied. marvels-spider-man.fandom.com answers the API, with about 87 linked pages, including "Marvel's Spider-Man: The City That Never Sleeps"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's entry is the 2018 game (id 58134); the Steam app is Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered (1817070), whose schema calls it "Popcorn" (an internal codename). 38 of 78 Steam achievements are hidden. The three DLC blocks are tagged "CTNS: The Heist", "CTNS: Turf Wars" and "CTNS: Silver Lining"; the 17 achievements listed inside those blocks (including three identically worded Screwball ones and two identically worded "Complete all Crimes in a district") were placed by schema position (12 of them hidden). The other 26 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder; several (such as "Pigeon Hunter", "Hug It Out", "Snappy Dresser", "Challenge Finder", "Master of Masters", "Spy Hunter", "A Bit of a Fixer-Upper") are probably side content and need checking. "Unacceptable" (the "Scales of Justice" mission) sits after the DLC blocks and the mission is not in the StrategyWiki walkthrough list, so it was put with city activities as a placeholder.
